description:
Read indexed RS3 drop items, quantities and listed rarities. Use get_wiki_entity_facts for combat stats or lookup_item for GE identities.

- page resolves redirects; put #variant only in variant. A supplied variant must match a returned sourceReference; omission includes all variants.
- offset counts source rows from zero, including malformed rows that are skipped. Follow nextOffset even after a short usable result. limit bounds rows, not kills/rolls; edits or tied names can shift boundaries.
- Missing/non-article sources error; unindexed articles yield empty rows. Unknown facts stay null.
- Listed probabilities are per row. Rolls and omitted conditions can change actual chances; consult the returned source link when hasOmittedAnnotations is true.

Each call reads article identity and the dropsline index without returning article prose/images. Uncached reads may lag and require no credentials. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor 429 Retry-After.

offset.description: nextOffset from a prior result; omit to start

page.description: Literal source article title, e.g. Abyssal demon; not an item ID or URL

variant.description: Exact sourceReference for one variant of the resolved article

name: get_wiki_drop_table

nextOffset.description: Continue with this offset; null means the index page ended or the 10000 offset bound was reached

title: Get Indexed Wiki Drop Facts
